clauses: Toggling the popover manager with the name `tailscale` opens the panel, and no element named `ts-back` exists

The four root rows are shown before the device list folds out; clicking `ts-devices-row` keeps them, draws the four `ts-peer` rows, grows the panel, turns `ts-devices-chevron` and focuses `ts-peer-search-input`; `ts-devices-card` lies strictly between `ts-devices-row` and `ts-exit-row-entry`
After `tango` is clicked, clicking `ts-devices-row` again shows no `ts-peer` row, turns the chevron back and restores the height within 1 px; reopening returns the identical delegate, still copied
With devices out, clicking `ts-exit-row-entry` keeps `ts-self-name`, hides every `ts-peer` and focuses `ts-exit-search-input`

With every sub-card shut, no `ts-settings-routes` row is shown; clicking `ts-settings-row` keeps `ts-self-name`, shows no `ts-peer`, grows the panel and turns `ts-settings-chevron`; `ts-settings-card` lies below its row; clicking again hides `ts-settings-routes`, turns the chevron back and restores the height within 1 px
